name: 74HC4051PW,118
title: 8-channel analog multiplexer/demultiplexer
summary: The 74HC4051 and 74HCT4051 are CMOS single-pole eight-throw analog switches: three select inputs S0 to S2 pick which of the eight terminals Y0 to Y7 connects to the common terminal Z, and an active-LOW enable E opens every switch when HIGH. Signals pass either way, so the part works as an 8:1 multiplexer or 1:8 demultiplexer for analog or digital signals. A separate VEE supply lets the switch path swing below ground, to ±5 V, while the logic inputs stay referred to GND and VCC. On the 74HCT4051 the select and enable inputs switch at VIH 2.0 V min and VIL 0.8 V max from a 4.5 V to 5.5 V supply; both types are specified from -40 °C to +125 °C.

circuits.title: Test circuit for measuring RON
circuits.description: The selected channel is on. A source sets Vis on Yn against VEE, a current source ISW is connected from Z to VEE, and a voltmeter across Yn and Z reads Vsw. RON is Vsw divided by ISW. Vis runs from 0 V to VCC - VEE.
notes: Sn stands for any select input, taken as S0; Yn for any channel terminal, taken as Y0.

circuits.title: Test circuit for measuring OFF-state current
circuits.description: The channel is off. Vis drives Yn through one ammeter and Vos drives Z through another; each reads the leakage on its side. The two cases are Vis = VCC with Vos = VEE, and Vis = VEE with Vos = VCC.
notes: Sn stands for any select input, taken as S0; Yn for any channel terminal, taken as Y0.

circuits.title: Test circuit for measuring ON-state current
circuits.description: The channel is on, its select input held HIGH, and Z is left open. Vis drives Yn through an ammeter that reads the leakage, once at Vis = VCC and once at Vis = VEE.
notes: Sn stands for any select input, taken as S0; Yn for any channel terminal, taken as Y0.

circuits.title: Test circuit for measuring switching times
circuits.description: A pulse generator drives the input under test, terminated by RT to ground. The output carries CL to ground and RL to switch S1, which goes to VCC, to VEE or nowhere as the test data table sets for each measurement.

parts.note: equal to the generator's output impedance ZO

notes: IN is the input under test; VIS the analog input level.
Test data table: S1 open for tPHL and tPLH, at VEE for tPZH and tPHZ, at VCC for tPZL and tPLZ.

circuits.title: Test circuit for measuring sine-wave distortion
circuits.description: A sine source Vis feeds the switch input through a 10 µF capacitor. The output carries RL and CL to ground and goes to a dB meter reading Vos.
notes: Sn stands for any select input, taken as S0; Yn for any channel terminal, taken as Y0. Either Yn or Z may be the input.

circuits.title: Test circuit for measuring isolation (OFF-state)
circuits.description: With the channel off, a sine source Vis feeds the input through 0.1 µF; the output carries RL and CL to ground and a dB meter reads what leaks through. Supplies VCC 4.5 V and VEE -4.5 V against GND at 0 V; RL is 600 Ω and RS 1 kΩ.
notes: Sn stands for any select input, taken as S0; Yn for any channel terminal, taken as Y0. Either Yn or Z may be the input.

circuits.title: Test circuit for measuring crosstalk between control input and any switch
circuits.description: A square-wave generator drives a select or enable input. Each switch terminal sits at the middle of a 2RL divider between VCC and VEE; the Z side also carries a capacitor to ground and an oscilloscope that reads the peak-to-peak spike Vct coupled from the control edge.
notes: The control input is Sn or E, taken as S0; Yn is taken as Y0.

circuits.title: Test circuit for frequency response
circuits.description: A sine source Vis feeds the input through 10 µF; the output carries RL and CL to ground and a dB meter reads Vos across frequency. Supplies VCC 4.5 V and VEE -4.5 V against GND at 0 V; RL is 50 Ω and RS 1 kΩ.
notes: Sn stands for any select input, taken as S0; Yn for any channel terminal, taken as Y0. Either Yn or Z may be the input.

where.Vsw: voltage across the closed switch, Yn to Z

equations.name: Dynamic power dissipation
equations.expr: PD = CPD × VCC² × fi × N + Σ{(CL + Csw) × VCC² × fo}

where.CPD: power dissipation capacitance per switch, pF (25 pF typ)

operation.text: S2, S1 and S0 make a 3-bit binary number, S0 the lowest bit; with E LOW the channel of that number is closed between its Yn terminal and Z, and the other seven are open. The switches pass signals both ways, so Z can be the input (demultiplexer) or the output (multiplexer).
E is active LOW. With E HIGH every switch is open, whatever the select inputs hold.

The select and enable inputs swing between GND and VCC; the Yn and Z terminals swing between VEE and VCC. With VEE below GND, 5 V logic can switch analog signals of ±5 V. On the 74HC4051, VCC - GND and VCC - VEE may each be 2.0 V to 10.0 V within the operating area of Fig. 5; on the 74HCT4051, VCC - GND is 4.5 V to 5.5 V and VCC - VEE is 2.0 V to 10.0 V (Fig. 6).
Analog signals from -5 V to +5 V can be switched.

On the 74HC4051 the input thresholds rise with VCC: at VCC = 4.5 V, VIH is 3.15 V min and VIL 1.35 V max. On the 74HCT4051, from VCC = 4.5 V to 5.5 V, VIH is 2.0 V min and VIL 0.8 V max, and each input held at VCC - 2.1 V adds supply current ΔICC.
Break-before-make switching is built in, as a typical property.
The inputs have clamp diodes, so an input can be fed from a voltage above VCC through a series current-limiting resistor.

When switch current enters a Yn terminal, a drop above 0.4 V across the switch draws VCC current out of Z. Current entering Z draws no VCC current from the Yn terminals and puts no limit on the drop. In both cases Yn and Z stay within VEE to VCC.
As VCC - VEE nears 2.0 V the ON resistance turns strongly non-linear; at a 2 V supply the part is recommended for digital signals only.

tpd covers tPHL and tPLH, measured from Vis to Vos at the 50 % points; ton covers tPZH and tPZL and toff covers tPHZ and tPLZ, measured from E or Sn at VM to the output at 50 %, 10 % or 90 %. VM is 0.5 × VCC on the 74HC4051 and 1.3 V on the 74HCT4051; the 74HCT4051 inputs are driven to VI = 3 V.
On DHVQFN16 and DHXQFN16 the center pad is marked VCC but carries no supply. It needs no solder joint; a soldered land is left floating or tied to VCC.
Latch-up performance exceeds 100 mA (JESD 78 Class II Level B). ESD: HBM (ANSI/ESDA/JEDEC JS-001 class 2) above 2000 V; CDM (ANSI/ESDA/JEDEC JS-002 class C3) above 1000 V.
Meets JEDEC JESD8C (2.7 V to 3.6 V) and JESD7A (2.0 V to 6.0 V). Specified over -40 °C to +85 °C and -40 °C to +125 °C.
